title: ppGpp pool over the cell cycle (both seeds)
caption: ppGpp concentration settles into a steady ~60-70 uM band.
interpretation: ppGpp concentration trajectories for both seeds: from a ~26 uM startup the pool rises into a steady ~60-70 uM band (median ~67 uM, max ~83 uM). The stable ppGpp pool indicates a balanced stringent-response signal at steady growth.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
